people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”
translations.bsb: For John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
translations.kjv: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.
translations.asv: For John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days hence.
